description: Faster R-CNN R50-FPN, COCO weights, torchvision defaults
smaller anchors (16-256 px) + 2x more RPN proposals for small, dense objects
RoI sampling 1024 per image with 50% positives (dense scenes have many positives)
GIoU loss instead of smooth L1 for the second-stage box regression
RetinaNet R50-FPN v2, COCO weights, torchvision defaults
anchors from the EDA object sizes - P3 starts at 16 px (16-406 px instead of 32-813 px)
looser anchor assignment - positive at IoU >= 0.4, negative below 0.3
focal loss gamma 1.5 instead of 2 - less down-weighting of easy anchors
RetinaNet tuned - P3 anchors from 16 px with wider octave scales (16-645 px), focal gamma 1.5
